units: <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 2:3">Midd. II, 3</cite> <he>רום מ׳</he> the height of every step; a. e.—Pl. <he>מַעֲלוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 5:4">Succ. V, 4</cite> <he>חמשה עשר מ׳ היורדות … שיר המ׳</he> fifteen steps leading down …, corresponding to the fifteen ‘Songs of Steps’ (<cite ref="Psalms 120">Ps. CXX</cite> to CXXXIV). Ib. 53ᵃ <he>הני חמש עשרה מ׳</he> those fifteen (Songs of) Steps.
<cite ref="Yoma 23a:16">Yoma 23ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ האולם</he> the steps in front of the Temple hall (<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 1:12">Tosef. ib. I, 12</cite> <he>פתח</he>); a. fr.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:17">Num. R. s. 15</cite> <he>מַעֲלָתָן של צדיקים מ׳ וכ׳</he> the rise of the righteous is a rise without a decline; <he>מַעֲלָתוֹ של עשו מ׳ שכולה וכ׳</he> Esau’s (a Roman’s) rise is a rise which may lead to degradation; a. e.

<cite ref="Yoma 44a:10">Yoma 44ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:8">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>הוי מה מ׳ יש בין וכ׳</he> now, there is no gradation of sanctity between the interior of the Temple and the space …, except &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 13a:17">Keth. 13ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מ׳ עשו ביוחסין</he> where priestly descent is concerned, they put up a higher standard (made the law more stringent).
Kidd. 70ᵇ זו מ׳ יתירה יש בין וכ׳ this is the distinction of Israelites over converts; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Yoma 44b:2">Yoma 44ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ דאוריתא</he> the gradations in sanctity are of Biblical origin (v.
Kel. I, 8, sq.).—3) height, on high. Mekh. Mishp. s. 15 עין של מ׳ the eye of the Lord. Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 2:1">Ḥag. II, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 2:11">11</cite>) <he>מה למ׳</he> (Ms. M. a. Y. ed. <he>למעלן</he>) what is on high; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1">Gen. R. s. 1</cite>; a. fr.—Freq. <cite ref="M02138"><he>מַעֲלָן</he></cite>, <he>לְמַעֲלָן</he>, <he>שֶׁלְּמַעֲלָן</he>, <he>מִלְּמַ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M00971"><he>מַטָּה</he></cite>.—
